set.description: 认识三角形的边、角、顶点，按边（不等边、等腰、等边）和按角（锐角、直角、钝角）对三角形分类。
set.name: Concept and Classification of Triangles

criteria: 能求常见完全平方数的平方根
会化简 √(a²)
set.description: 会用平方运算求完全平方数的平方根，了解 √(a²)=|a|，并能用计算器求近似值。
set.name: Finding Square Roots
set.nameZh: 开平方与平方根的求法

criteria: 能由一个锐角求另一个锐角
能判断有两角互余的三角形形状
set.description: 直角三角形的两个锐角互余；有两个角互余的三角形是直角三角形。
set.name: The two acute angles of a right triangle are complementary
set.nameZh: 直角三角形的两个锐角互余

criteria: 能叙述性质
能用性质计算
set.description: 矩形的四个角都是直角，对角线相等且互相平分。
set.name: Properties of Rectangles

set.reason: Acute-angle complementarity is not in the side-length equation. It can usefully identify a right triangle when the angle is not given, supporting a restricted preparation link rather than the original hard claim. This acceptance is a new final mathematical judgment, not a mistaken activation from the prior native accept of Claude's rejection.
set.scope: Optionally identifying an unmarked right triangle from complementary acute angles

set.reason: The theorem's third-side computation requires taking a nonnegative square root of a sum or difference of squares.
set.scope: computing the third side from two sides

set.reason: The theorem relates the sides of a right triangle; acute-angle complementarity is unnecessary. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Right-triangle, hypotenuse and leg meanings in the Pythagorean assertion

set.reason: The square target expressly combines rectangle and rhombus properties; rectangle meaning and its right-angle/equal-diagonal properties are the appropriate content, rather than the general rectangle recognition repertoire. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: The rectangle-property component inherited by a square and its inclusion in the rectangle class

set.reason: Interior angle sums help with angle work. However, radius and apothem come from the central angle 360/n and a right triangle, and the interior angle follows from the central angle too.
set.scope: angle facts of regular polygons

set.reason: The triangle circumcircle introduces circles through all vertices, which eases the generalization. Regular polygon center and radius can be defined via symmetry or equal division of a circle.
set.scope: circumscribed circle of a regular polygon

criteria: 能说出正多边形的相关量
能计算正多边形的半径与边心距
set.description: 正多边形有外接圆和内切圆，认识中心、半径、边心距、中心角，并作正多边形。
set.name: Regular Polygons and Circles

criteria: 能说出圆的面积用半径计算
能算出简单的圆面积
set.description: 会用半径乘半径再乘圆周率求圆的面积。
set.name: Area of a circle

criteria: 能叙述定理
能已知两边求第三边
set.description: 直角三角形两直角边的平方和等于斜边的平方：a²+b²=c²。
set.name: Pythagorean theorem

criteria: 能说出正方形的性质
能画出四类四边形的包含关系图
set.description: 正方形兼有矩形和菱形的性质，会判定正方形并梳理平行四边形、矩形、菱形、正方形的包含关系。
set.name: Properties and Criteria for Squares

criteria: 能说出圆上的点到圆心的距离都等于半径
知道直径等于半径的 2 倍
set.description: 认识圆心、半径和直径，会用圆规画圆，知道同一圆里半径都相等。
set.name: Understanding Circles

criteria: 能推导内角和公式
能用公式求边数或角度
set.description: n 边形内角和为 (n-2)×180°，可通过分割成三角形推导。
set.name: Sum of the Interior Angles of a Polygon

criteria: 能说出外心的性质
能确定直角三角形外心位置
set.description: 经过三角形三个顶点的圆叫外接圆，圆心是三边垂直平分线的交点，叫外心。
set.name: Circumcircle of a Triangle
